Geolite

Credits and licenses · v0.3.184 · Cousins Studios

Game

  • Design, code and soundtrack: Cousins Studios. The soundtrack was created by the studio with AKAI.
  • Art: Cousins Studios. The base was conceived by the studio and scaffolded with AI tools; the hand work and the polish are human: every piece is retouched, redrawn and polished by hand to the game's native pixel grid.

Sound effects

  • Chips and cards (room ambience and sound effects): Casino Audio by Kenney — Creative Commons Zero, CC0 (text). Everything else in the sound effects is synthesized by the game.

Soundtrack

Each song plays in three layers (title screen, game and last seconds). The original 22 songs remain available as the “Classic” music style (Settings > Sound > Music style).

  • 01. Sure Bet (lounge nocturno, 1:30)
  • 02. Double or Nothing (boogaloo de jazz, 1:26)
  • 03. Both Teams to Score (bossa lo-fi, 1:39)
  • 04. Over 2.5 Goals (samba-jazz, 1:37)

  • 06. Orphans (vals de jazz, 1:33)
  • 07. All In (jazz-funk, 1:41)

  • 09. Raise the Stakes (latin jazz, 1:39)
  • 10. Cash Out (lo-fi, 1:52)
  • 11. Bankroll (dub, 1:40)
  • 12. Live Bet (jazz-hop, 1:48)
  • 13. Straight Up (flamenco-jazz, 1:34)
